paragraphs: Yose: Rabbi Yochanan ben Yose and Rabbi Yaakov ben Yose. Abba Mari, Rabbi Yose’s brother. Rabbi Abba, son of Rabbi Yose’s brother: Shekalim, chapter 2. Rabbi Adda ben Yose. Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Yose. Rabbi Yonatan be-Rabbi Yose. Rabbi Shmuel be-Rabbi Yose. [Glosses: Yose. (1) Pesachim 7a, beginning: ‘Rav Giddel said: Rabbi Chiyya bar Yose said: Rav said.’ The same matter there, 21b, beginning: ‘Rabbi Chiyya bar Yosef said: Rabbi Yochanan said.’ It was not corrected. (2) Rosh, end of Avodah Zarah, chapter 1: ‘Rav Yehudah said: Shmuel said, the law follows Rabbi Meir’ should read ‘Rabbi Yose,’ as in the Gemara and Rif. (3) Berakhot 4b, end: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said, ‘Although he recited Shema,’ and so forth; Rabbi Yose said, ‘What is the verse?’ Perhaps it should read ‘Rabbi Yose bar Chanina said, What is the verse?’ (4) Shabbat 62b: Rabbi Yose said; Ein Yaakov has be-Rabbi Chanina. (5) Keritot 25b: ‘When Ravin came: Rabbi Yose said: Resh Lakish said.’ It seems to me it should read ‘Rabbi Yose bar Chanina said: Resh Lakish said,’ for in Chullin 101b Ravin sent in Rabbi Yose bar Chanina’s name, and in many places Rabbi Yose bar Chanina spoke in Resh Lakish’s name. (6) Beitzah 7a, end: Yose ben Shaul said in Rav’s name; perhaps it should read Rabbi, as in many places. Sheerit Yosef included him among Rav’s students and erred, as I wrote in the principles. (7) Bava Kamma 112b: Rabbi Yose bar Abbahu; perhaps it should read Abba. See there; it was not corrected. (8) Menachot 70b: Rabbi Yose ben Zavda; Sukkah 37b, end: Zavla; Shabbat 96a: Zavda; most places: Zevida. It was not corrected. (9) Zevachim 25b: Rabbi Yochanan said in Rabbi Yose bar Abba’s name. There, 97a: Rabbi Yochanan said in Abba Yose ben Abba’s name. (10) Beitzah 8b: Rabbi Yose bar Chama; it seems to me it should read Yosef. It was not corrected. (11) Chagigah 13b, end: Abba Yose ben Dosai should read Dostai. It was not corrected. Berakhot 28a: Abba Yosef ben Dostai should read Yose. It was not corrected. Chullin 49a: Rav Yosef bar Dosai should read Abba Yose ben Dostai. It was not corrected. (12) Menachot 87a: Rabbi Yosef should read Rav. It was not corrected. (13) Berakhot 26a: Rav Yosef bar Chanina should read Yose, as in Rif and Rosh. (14) Berakhot 52b: Rabbi Yose bar Chanina said: Rabbi Huna said. It should read Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chanina, as in Rif and Rosh. (15) Bava Metzia 70a: Rabbah son of Rabbi Yosef bar Chama said in Rav Sheshet’s name. Rosh and Rif have Rav Yosef bar Chama. It was not corrected. (16) Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 34a, s.v. Mita’anin LeSha’ot, says Rabbi Yose HaGelili’s son died. This is a scribal error, for Jerusalem Talmud, Nedarim 8:1, has the unqualified Rabbi Yose. But there too is a scribal error, since the unqualified Rabbi Yose is ben Chalafta, and Rabbi Yonah did not live in his time. The same matter appears in Jerusalem Talmud, Megalchin, halakhah 7, as Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Abbahu’s son. (17) Menachot 33b: Rav Yosef son of Rav should read ‘of Rava.’ It was not corrected. (18) Shabbat 118b, end: Rav Yosef told Rabbi Yosef son of Rabbah; it should read ‘of Rava,’ and it was not corrected. Beitzah 25b, end, also has ‘son of Rabbah,’ uncorrected.]
